note: Family-run nine-hole golf course with an RV campground on Hwy 12 east of Rocky Mountain House. Spacious sites between two ravines, treed in the older section and open elsewhere; clubhouse, cabin and domes. Six people and one vehicle per site; no generators. Seasonal campers get weekday green-fee rates. --Claude
